matched_signals.name: Stoppage dominates transit time

matched_signals.name: Significant detour (transit ≫ planned)
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove much further than the planned route — at least 25% extra distance. That kind of detour usually means an unscheduled stop or a route swap mid-trip.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip travelled >25% more than the Google route — off-route detour.

matched_signals.name: Stoppage dominates transit time
matched_signals.human_text: The truck spent more time stopped than moving — over 40% of the trip was stationary. That much halt time on a delivery run is unusual.
matched_signals.rationale: Stoppage hours ≥ 40% of transit hours with min 1hr stoppage.

matched_signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove at least 15km more than the planned distance. On a short city run, that's a significant detour off the optimal route.
matched_signals.rationale: Driven distance > planned + 15km.

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time
matched_signals.human_text: The cargo was 'unloaded' in under 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit. That's too fast for legitimate offload — usually means the cargo wasn't actually delivered, or was already gone.
matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: Slow loading at origin
matched_signals.human_text: Loading at the origin took 3+ hours — much longer than normal. That extended dwell is a window where cargo can be swapped or tampered with before the trip even starts.
matched_signals.rationale: Loading dwell ≥ 3h suggests pre-trip tampering or substitution window.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing
matched_signals.human_text: There's no record of the truck actually arriving at the destination. The trip was closed without a confirmed dock-in event.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.name: ETA breached significantly
matched_signals.human_text: The trip arrived 4+ hours after the planned ETA — far beyond normal traffic variance. That much delay usually means an unaccounted detour or extended stop.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Stoppage dominates transit time

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time

matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing
matched_signals.human_text: There's no record of the truck actually arriving at the destination. The trip was closed without a confirmed dock-in event.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.name: ETA breached significantly

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove at least 15km more than the planned distance. On a short city run, that's a significant detour off the optimal route.
matched_signals.rationale: Driven distance > planned + 15km.

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time
matched_signals.human_text: The cargo was 'unloaded' in under 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit. That's too fast for legitimate offload — usually means the cargo wasn't actually delivered, or was already gone.
matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: Slow loading at origin
matched_signals.human_text: Loading at the origin took 3+ hours — much longer than normal. That extended dwell is a window where cargo can be swapped or tampered with before the trip even starts.
matched_signals.rationale: Loading dwell ≥ 3h suggests pre-trip tampering or substitution window.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing
matched_signals.human_text: There's no record of the truck actually arriving at the destination. The trip was closed without a confirmed dock-in event.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.name: ETA breached significantly
matched_signals.human_text: The trip arrived 4+ hours after the planned ETA — far beyond normal traffic variance. That much delay usually means an unaccounted detour or extended stop.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time
matched_signals.human_text: The cargo was 'unloaded' in under 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit. That's too fast for legitimate offload — usually means the cargo wasn't actually delivered, or was already gone.
matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing
matched_signals.human_text: There's no record of the truck actually arriving at the destination. The trip was closed without a confirmed dock-in event.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Slow loading at origin
matched_signals.human_text: Loading at the origin took 3+ hours — much longer than normal. That extended dwell is a window where cargo can be swapped or tampered with before the trip even starts.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.name: ETA breached significantly

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Alerts fired during trip
matched_signals.human_text: The platform raised one or more alerts during this trip — halts, route deviations or geofence breaches that operations should have looked at.
matched_signals.rationale: One or more in-transit alerts (geofence, halt, route-deviation) raised by the platform.

matched_signals.name: Significant detour (transit ≫ planned)
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove much further than the planned route — at least 25% extra distance. That kind of detour usually means an unscheduled stop or a route swap mid-trip.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip travelled >25% more than the Google route — off-route detour.

matched_signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove at least 15km more than the planned distance. On a short city run, that's a significant detour off the optimal route.
matched_signals.rationale: Driven distance > planned + 15km.

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time
matched_signals.human_text: The cargo was 'unloaded' in under 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit. That's too fast for legitimate offload — usually means the cargo wasn't actually delivered, or was already gone.
matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: ETA breached significantly
matched_signals.human_text: The trip arrived 4+ hours after the planned ETA — far beyond normal traffic variance. That much delay usually means an unaccounted detour or extended stop.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.

matched_signals.name: Significant detour (transit ≫ planned)
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove much further than the planned route — at least 25% extra distance. That kind of detour usually means an unscheduled stop or a route swap mid-trip.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip travelled >25% more than the Google route — off-route detour.

matched_signals.name: Stoppage dominates transit time
matched_signals.human_text: The truck spent more time stopped than moving — over 40% of the trip was stationary. That much halt time on a delivery run is unusual.
matched_signals.rationale: Stoppage hours ≥ 40% of transit hours with min 1hr stoppage.

matched_signals.name: Transit distance far exceeds Google distance
matched_signals.human_text: The truck drove at least 15km more than the planned distance. On a short city run, that's a significant detour off the optimal route.
matched_signals.rationale: Driven distance > planned + 15km.

matched_signals.name: Suspicious low unloading time
matched_signals.human_text: The cargo was 'unloaded' in under 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit. That's too fast for legitimate offload — usually means the cargo wasn't actually delivered, or was already gone.
matched_signals.rationale: Cargo offloaded in < 6 minutes after a multi-hour transit — likely concealed offload.

matched_signals.name: Destination entry missing
matched_signals.human_text: There's no record of the truck actually arriving at the destination. The trip was closed without a confirmed dock-in event.
matched_signals.rationale: Trip closed without a destination-geofence entry event on a non-trivial trip.

matched_signals.rationale: Trip closure ≥4h past the Google ETA — extended off-route or unaccounted dwell.
